data.body:
Patch set 2 added a regression test for the `git fetch origin` failure handler, closing the single advisory the review bot raised on patch set 1 (that branch was the one named-handler without its own test). Confirmed RED against the pre-fix Makefile before landing it.

Gerrit change 2642 final state:
- LLM-Review +1 (PASS, no findings) on patch set 2
- Verified +1 on patch set 2 (https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/33927191139)
- 0 unresolved comments
- Status MERGED as 6c2267d8d7b1

NOTE for the operator: this session did NOT submit the change. Gerrit records the submit at 23:23:51 under the `Rebar Bot Nava` identity, ~3 minutes after the `Verified +1` landed at 23:20:40, with no submit call from this session. Something else on this host running under the same Gerrit identity (an automation, or a concurrent agent session) submitted it. Worth confirming, since it means a change can land without the session that authored it deciding to land it.

Ticket deliberately left `in_progress` — the operator asked to close it themselves.
